sasha: Heads-up — saw a p95 spike on the A/B canary after the runtime merge (7b3f2a). A-side (new kernel selector + batching heuristics) latency up ~35% vs baseline :eyes:

miguel: CI perf job failed earlier on that PR, but tests were flaky so it got merged. I flagged it but no block.

perf-bot: PERF CHECK — PR 4823 merge 7b3f2a: ci/perf/regressions: p95_tokens increased from 48ms -> 65ms on g4dn, throughput down 8%.

anna: Can someone run a quick bisect on 7b3f2a -> master? If it's kernel selection we should revert kernel choice first.

ben: I'll take bisect. Quick note: can reproduce locally with the small-randomized-load harness. Starting bisect now.

ben: (update) narrowed to commit range 7b3f2a..7b3f2a~5 — change that adds "auto_kern_pref" heuristics and a batching window bump.

meera: The batching window bump + aggressive prefix cache invalidation change could increase tail latency for mixed short/long sequences. We saw similar in perf runs last quarter.

ben: Here's a flamegraph snippet from the canary profile (sampled):
```
flamegraph: runtime_loop -> select_kernel -> batch_builder -> wait_for_batch (+ 40%)
hot: select_kernel (new_pref) hotpath
```

ryan: If the failure is reproducible, we should update the canary gating to check p95 token latency and active KV miss rate. Proposal: auto-pause + rollback if p95 > 1.2x baseline for 5 continuous minutes OR KV-miss-rate increases > 3x.

anna: Agree. Add a short-circuit in rollout-policy: canary-slo-check that evaluates every minute and triggers instant rollback via deploy API.

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT: canary A/B paused (A flagged). Triggered by metric-watch rule: runtime/p95_tokens > 1.2x for 3m. Action: hold new variant and notify #eng-runtime.

miguel: We should avoid a full revert until we confirm selector vs batching. Canary rollback buys time. Also add a CI gate: block merges that increase p95 by >10% on perf job.

meera: For mitigations: try reverting only auto_kern_pref and keep batching window. If that restores p95, we can iterate on selector heuristics.

ben: Reverted auto_kern_pref in a hotfix branch and re-ran local canary — p95 back within 5% of baseline. I'll open PR to revert that change in master if CI agrees.

anna: Thanks. Action items: 1) ben opens revert PR, 2) miguel wires CI perf hard-block for >10% p95, 3) ryan pushes the canary-slo-check policy (auto-rollback thresholds).

ryan: I'll draft the policy and the deploybot automation today. Suggestion: when auto-rollback happens, attach the last 10s profiler dump to the incident thread.

sasha: Nice work. Add a short postmortem note to the rollout doc once PR lands. :thumbsup:
